As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

Current university students and recent graduates.

About the team:

The Global Events team is responsible for delivering Binance's most strategic and high-profile experiences around the world. From flagship conferences and executive summits to VIP experiences, community events and creator programmes, we create memorable moments that strengthen our brand, engage our users and support business growth.

Our team manages a diverse portfolio of global events, including flagship events, sponsorship activations and community initiatives. We work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Business Development, Legal, Security, Operations and regional teams to execute world-class events across multiple markets.

As a fast-paced global team, we thrive in an environment where no two events are the same. We value ownership, adaptability, collaboration and a willingness to solve complex challenges.

Role Overview

Responsible for end-to-end quality assurance across Web and App (mobile) surfaces — combining automated and exploratory testing to ensure product stability, compatibility, and interaction experience from the user's perspective. The core requirement is cross-platform testing capability (Web + App), with the ability to design and maintain an automated testing system and to think deeply about troubleshooting and user-experience-oriented quality.

In one sentence: This role is the quality gatekeeper for Web/App products — someone who can write automation scripts, test interaction experiences, investigate data issues, and use engineering methods to replace manual testing with systematic automated quality coverage. Not a manual tester — a QA engineer with real coding ability.
